## format() function

Formats shell source into the canonical text of mvdan/sh's printer (the `shfmt` style).

The text is parsed and printed through `sh-ast`<!-- -->, so the result is determined by the AST alone: layout, blank-line runs and `\r\n` line endings in the input do not survive, while comments and here-document bodies do. Formatting is idempotent.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function format(text: string, options?: FormatOptions): string;
```

## Exceptions

TypeError with `SH_CODEMOD_SERVICE_OPTION` for invalid project options or removed names.

[FormatSyntaxError](./sh-codemod.formatsyntaxerror.md) when `text` is not valid in the selected dialect, or source contains a literal vertical tab or form feed that the printer cannot preserve. Unicode source characters are preserved by the parser and printer. Native nesting refusals (`ShParseMaxDepthError`<!-- -->, `SH_AST_PARSE_MAX_DEPTH`<!-- -->) propagate unchanged. Other `sh-ast` failures (`PrintError` for incompatible printer options such as `Minify` with `SingleLine`<!-- -->, code `SH_AST_SYNTAX_PRINT`<!-- -->; `PrintPanicError`<!-- -->, code `SH_AST_SYNTAX_PRINT_PANIC`<!-- -->; `InputError`<!-- -->, code `SH_AST_SYNTAX_INPUT`<!-- -->, for malformed Unicode source/filename or rejected upstream printer knobs; and bridge failures with `SH_AST_INTERNAL`<!-- -->) are thrown as they are.
